object: TO SEPARATE WATER AND CHLOROFORM FROM THEIR

The mixture of two immiscible liquids like chloroform and water can be separated by using the device like separating funnel. When the mixture is taken into this device, chloroform (an organic liquid) forms the bottom layer and water forms the upper layer. The two •layers are separated by controlled opening of the tap of the separating funnel.
Take the mixture of chloroform and water (in nearly 1:5 ratio by volume) in a separating funnel. Close the funnel with the stopper.
Shake the mixture for about a minute. Hold the funnel vertically to allow the components of the mixture to settle.
The liquids form two distinct layers. Remove the stopper and slowly open the tap to run down the bottom layer (chloroform) into a beaker.
Practical Chemistry Close the tap just before the line of demarcation reaches the tap.
Reject the liquid just above and just below the line of demarcation by opening the tap.
Run down the upper layer (water) into another beaker.
Water and chloroform were separated from their mixture using a separating funnel.
